Jericho, Joshua 5 and 6. The Lord was with Joshua, and He gave a strange battle plan, not a loud first rush, but a quiet circle of obedience day after day, then a shout, and a wall that fell, because God is God. Obedience that looks like walking and waiting can still be strong. If God has told you a clear step, stay with Him even if the first days feel like circles—He keeps His word.
